\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize $R$, $L$, $C$: cross-model means of the right, left and centrist ideology scores (0--10). IDEO is the measure used in the paper; IDEO$_{c}$ adds the centrist score to the denominator. Because IDEO$_{c}$ $=$ IDEO $\times(R+L)/(R+L+C)$, the centrist score never changes the sign; it only shrinks the magnitude towards zero.\end{minipage}
